title: Dwarven Thrower

sources.title: Dwarven Thrower (passive feature)
markers: | description = When a [[Dwarf|dwarf]] <!--Descriptions here should almost always exactly match in-game tool tips. While race is normally capitalised, it is not here for this reason.-->  throws this warhammer, it deals an extra {{DamageText|1d8|Bludgeoning}} damage, or an extra {{DamageText|2d8|Bludgeoning}} damage if the target is a Large, Huge, or Gargantuan creature.

sources.title: Homing Weapon
markers: | description = This weapon will return to its owner when thrown.

sources.title: Throw
markers: | description = Throw a character or item from the world or your inventory.

summary: A +2 warhammer that returns when thrown and can deal bonus Bludgeoning damage when thrown by a Dwarf.

fields.Throw: Use the Throw action. The hammer returns to the wielder.
fields.Dwarven Thrower: On a throw by a Dwarf, add 1d8 Bludgeoning, or 2d8 if the target is Large, Huge or Gargantuan. The linked rule reports that a Dwarf disguise also activates this when equipping.
fields.Acquisition: Ferg Drogher sells it. The source says he will refuse trade if Shadowheart is nearby unless she killed the Nightsong.
fields.Base value: 770 gp in BG3. Merchant prices vary.

changes: Added native BG3 gameplay use and reviewed pinned source evidence.
